start.text: A blizzard: the wind drives thick snow, nothing can be seen five steps away, frost.
start.indoors: The wind howls in the chimney and hurls snow at the windows.

changes.text: The blizzard is dying down: the snow falls thin and even, the wind has dropped, one can see as far as the gate.
changes.indoors: The howling in the chimney has died down, it is quiet outside the windows.

changes.text: The sky is clear, stars, hard frost; the snow creaks underfoot.
changes.indoors: Outside the windows it is clear and starry, the panes are covered in frost patterns.
